FIVEELEMENTS-LINE_ECHO: It's the [gold]Echo[/gold], the element of the last card played this turn.
FIVEELEMENTS-LINE_ACTIVE: Cards of that element will trigger their bonus effect.
FIVEELEMENTS-LINE_INACTIVE: Card of that element won't trigger their bonus effect.
FIVEELEMENTS-LINE_WATER: [gold]Water[/gold] is active if the last card played this turn is either Water or Metal, or if you have its [gold]Essence[/gold].
FIVEELEMENTS-LINE_WOOD: [gold]Wood[/gold] is active if the last card played this turn is either Wood or Water, or if you have its [gold]Essence[/gold].
FIVEELEMENTS-LINE_FIRE: [gold]Fire[/gold] is active if the last card played this turn is either Fire or Wood, or if you have its [gold]Essence[/gold].
FIVEELEMENTS-LINE_EARTH: [gold]Earth[/gold] is active if the last card played this turn is either Earth or Fire, or if you have its [gold]Essence[/gold].
FIVEELEMENTS-LINE_METAL: [gold]Metal[/gold] is active if the last card played this turn is either Metal or Earth, or if you have its [gold]Essence[/gold].
